name: Lease Deed (long-term / registered lease, TPA ss.105-117)
applies_to: Lease Deed (long-term / registered lease, TPA ss.105-117)
detect_keywords: term of \d+ years|for a (term|period) of \d+ years

sources.title: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (+ each State's Stamp Act/Schedule)
sources.where: https://www.indiacode.nic.in and the State IGR/Stamps dept.

sources.title: Delhi Revenue Dept. model deeds (Sale, Agreement to Sell, Lease, Exchange, Will, GPA, Gift)

required_clauses.title: Parties with full names, parentage/address and capacity
required_clauses.guidance: Names, father/spouse name, age, address. Parties must be majors of sound mind (Contract Act s.11).

required_clauses.title: Party identity proofs (PAN / Aadhaar)
required_clauses.guidance: PAN is required on high-value immovable property transactions; many states also record Aadhaar.

required_clauses.title: Property description (schedule, survey/plot no., area, boundaries)
required_clauses.guidance: Unambiguous identification of the property is essential for registration.

required_clauses.title: Words of demise / grant of lease
required_clauses.guidance: TPA s.105: transfer of right to enjoy property for a term, in consideration of price/rent.

required_clauses.title: Term, commencement and renewal option
required_clauses.guidance: Lease for over one year (or year-to-year) must be a registered instrument (s.107).

required_clauses.title: Lessee's covenants (pay rent, repair, use, restore)
Stamp duty paid (e-stamp / stamp paper details)
required_clauses.guidance: Instrument must be stamped as per the State Stamp Act before/at execution; unstamped documents are inadmissible until duty and penalty are paid.

required_clauses.title: Registration particulars (Sub-Registrar, Registration Act)
required_clauses.guidance: Registration Act s.17 makes registration compulsory for these instruments; present within 4 months of execution (s.23).

required_clauses.title: Declarations: no fraud, no coercion, facts true
required_clauses.guidance: Official formats (e.g. NGDRS Punjab) carry a no-fraud declaration with penal consequences under the Registration Act.

required_clauses.title: Place and date of execution; signatures
Signatures and attestation by two witnesses
required_clauses.guidance: Two attesting witnesses are mandatory for gift, mortgage and will; customary/State-required for others.

red_flags.title: Property transfer 'notarised' only / on plain paper
red_flags.why: Notarisation is not registration; immovable property transfers above the statutory limit need a registered, stamped instrument.

red_flags.title: 'GPA sale' / irrevocable GPA used as a transfer
red_flags.pattern: irrevocable (general )?power of attorney[^.]{0,120}(sell|sale|transfer|convey)|general power of attorney[^.]{0,80}(in lieu of|instead of) (sale|conveyance)
red_flags.why: Suraj Lamp v. State of Haryana (SC 2011): GPA/agreement/will sales do not convey title.

red_flags.title: Large cash consideration
red_flags.why: Cash receipts of Rs 20,000+ for immovable property are restricted under the Income-tax Act (ss.269SS/269ST); also undervaluation risk.

red_flags.title: Consideration expressly lower than market/circle rate
red_flags.why: Undervaluation attracts stamp-duty deficiency, penalty and tax consequences.

red_flags.title: Unfilled placeholders in final document
red_flags.why: Final deed should not contain blanks.

red_flags.title: Deed says it need not be registered
red_flags.pattern: (need|shall) not be registered|no need (to|for) regist|unregistered (deed|agreement) (is|shall be) (valid|binding)
red_flags.why: Compulsorily registrable instruments are not effective for transferring an interest without registration (Registration Act s.17, TPA s.54/107/123).

disclaimer: Checklist built from the cited central statutes and official state/NGDRS deed formats. Stamp duty rates, registration fees and some mandatory clauses are STATE-specific; verify with the State Registration & Stamps department. Not legal advice.
